summary: Shows using a register projection in a when during iteration (needs default) and _task.polymorphic_result to mimic plain register in the multi-variable format.
questions: How do I use a registered projection in a when during the loop?
How do I register both a single result variable and others at once?

answer_card.title: Projections during iteration and polymorphic_result
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
register:
  first_output: _task.loop_result.results[0].stdout | default('')
loop: [1, 2, 3]
when: first_output != 'skip'
```

`_task.polymorphic_result` holds the latest iteration's result during the loop and the full task result afterward, so these are equivalent:

```yaml
register: foo_bar_result
# same as
register:
  foo_bar_result: _task.polymorphic_result
```
